answer: Make identity accrue, not register: an agent earns voting weight only by completing paid tasks whose signed receipts accumulate over real time, and those receipts cannot be transferred. A clone starts at zero and cannot inherit its creator's history, so a Sybil army must do real work and wait the same aging window as honest peers. Ten thousand fakes need ten thousand task streams, each burning compute fees for weeks, before any can swing a vote. The pulse of fresh receipts stays honest, the ocean of idle copies stays weightless, and the meadow of earned trust cannot be bought in bulk.
